correctness.rationale: Binary meet preservation on a chain is equivalent to monotonicity. Pos is equivalent to f(p)>=p. Con is equivalent to f(c)<=c or f constant on [0,c], proved in both directions for all n>=1. Split by f(c)<=c vs >c; independent weakly increasing tails and hockey-stick sums yield both parity-sensitive exact enumerations and top-preserving formulas. Stirling estimates give all asymptotics. The packaged checker independently evaluated 174,908 maps, including all maps n<=6 and all isotone candidates n<=10. Finite experiments only corroborate the fully quantified proof.
